components.css: .ds-bisagra-sheet { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; gap: 32px 56px; padding: 36px 40px; background: #f47a36; color: #241f1b; } .ds-bisagra-sheet h2 { font: 700 clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3.6rem)/1.04 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-bisagra-sheet dt { font: 400 .9rem 'Barlow', sans-serif; } .ds-bisagra-sheet dd { font: 600 1.05rem/1.3 'Barlow', sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-bisagra-sheet { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 24px; gap: 24px; } }

components.css: .ds-checkout { width: min(560px, calc(100% - 24px)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px); padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--demo-line, #bfcee4); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--demo-paper, #fff); color: var(--demo-ink, #142542); overflow: hidden; } .ds-checkout::backdrop { background: rgb(10 20 30 / 65%); } .ds-toolbar { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--demo-paper, #fff); } .ds-toolbar button { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; } .ds-body { max-height: calc(100dvh - 100px); padding: 0 24px 24px; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; } .ds-body h3 { font: 600 1.4rem/1.2 var(--demo-display, system-ui); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-body { padding: 0 18px 24px; } }

narrative.northStar: Three Institute Worlds, One Honest Frame
narrative.overview:
CursoClaro is a work-first collection, not one universal storefront theme. Its homepage uses a restrained white, navy, cobalt, and Figtree gallery frame to introduce three fictional demonstrations. Each route then owns its own typography, palette, and composition: Alondra Idiomas is a jade timetable-first language school; Bisagra is an orange-and-yellow practical-trades course sheet; Casa Sauce is a plum-and-olive principal training edition. Do not flatten these identities into a shared marketing-page template.

The routes share useful behavior and infrastructure: the demo shell, accessible baseline, action primitives, native disclosures and controls, session filtering, and simulated checkout. Those shared mechanics take each route's scoped variables; they do not dictate common section order or visual composition. The examples and payment journey are explicitly demonstrations, not real institutes, integrations, proof, or administration tools.
keyCharacteristics: The homepage is a quiet collection frame; demo routes have independent visual worlds.
Alondra leads with a preselected A1 timetable and scannable session rows.
Bisagra reads as a practical course sheet, reservation strip, and open course rows.
Casa Sauce reads as a principal training edition with editorial serif display and olive course surfaces.
Shared behavior is functional infrastructure, not a common marketing composition.

rules.name: The Scoped-World Rule
rules.body: A route's palette applies only within that institute context. Shared components consume the active demo variables; never translate three accents into a single global palette.

rules.name: The Three-Family Rule
rules.body: Keep Figtree, Barlow/Barlow Condensed, and Lora/Karla assigned to their actual collection, Alondra, Bisagra, and Sauce contexts respectively.

dos: Do keep gallery tokens and composition scoped to the homepage and each demo's tokens scoped to its route.
Do preserve Alondra's A1-initial timetable and the session picker's native filtering, count, empty state, reset, and focus behavior.
Do preserve Bisagra's course-sheet/reservation-strip composition and Casa Sauce's training-edition composition.
Do reuse shared shell, accessible controls, session filtering, and simulated checkout as behavior without forcing common marketing sections.
Do describe fictional institutes and simulated payment honestly; use only verified content and implemented behavior.
donts: Don't apply homepage typography or color tokens to all three demos, or consolidate their distinct visual worlds.
Don't treat legacy styles or unused generic marketing components/data as active design authority for these routes.
Don't claim real customers, testimonials, outcomes, payments, reservations, confirmation actions, or an administrative panel.
Don't replace native selects, disclosures, or dialog behavior with nonfunctional visual stand-ins.
